corrects_assumption: Phase 4 is not greenfield for PubMed - a live, production-wired hybrid retrieval pipeline (retrieval/retriever.py: FAISS+BM25+RRF+cross-encoder rerank) already exists and is called from agent/nodes.py's synthesis_node, separate from Phase 3's live-API PubMed path. It has zero test coverage and one real corpus-reproducibility gap - both named in-scope Phase-4 work.

input.pubmed_note: Phase 4 may call retrieval/retriever.py's retrieve() directly (existing RAG path) in addition to or instead of live-API PubMed results as candidates - decided empirically by candidate comparison, not assumed.

output.not: Phase-5 Evidence object - no claim-level provenance, no citation numbering, no verification status
output.based_on: retrieval/retriever.py's existing Document dataclass (pmid, title, text, score, journal), extended with cross-source fields (source, candidate_id, dedup_group_id) that single-source dataclass didn't need

pubmed.requirement: chunk always traceable to parent article

clinical_trials.requirement: structured filter fidelity (phase/status/condition/intervention actually applied) preserved in source_metadata, never silently dropped

chembl.requirement: exact-entity lookup semantics, no fuzzy match presented as canonical

cross_source_ranking_rule: retrieval_score is source-local and not directly comparable across sources. Any cross-source display ordering must use an explicit documented method (per-source quotas, intent-aware allocation, normalized rank fusion) - never a naive sort by retrieval_score across sources. Method selection deferred to candidate comparison with evidence, not fixed by this contract.
